name: Analytical Reasoning
subject: analytical-reasoning

questions.question_text: If all Bloops are Razzies and some Razzies are Lazzies, which of the following must be true?
questions.explanation: Since some Razzies are Lazzies, by symmetry, some Lazzies must be Razzies.

questions.question_text: If A > B and B > C, which of the following is necessarily true?
questions.explanation: This follows the property of transitivity in inequalities.

questions.question_text: Seven people (A, B, C, D, E, F, G) are standing in a row. A is next to B, C is not next to D. This is an example of:
questions.explanation: The items are described as standing in a line, defining a linear arrangement problem.

questions.question_text: If 'No birds are mammals' and 'All bats are mammals', what must be true?
questions.explanation: Since no birds are mammals and all bats are inside the mammals group, no bats can be birds.

questions.question_text: Five students are ranked by height. If X is taller than Y, Y is taller than Z, and W is shorter than Z, who is the shortest?
questions.explanation: The hierarchy is X > Y > Z > W. W is at the bottom of the list.

questions.question_text: Which statement is the logical negation of 'All men are honest'?
questions.explanation: The negation of a universal affirmative (All A are B) is a particular negative (Some A are not B).

questions.question_text: If X is north of Y and Z is east of Y, in what direction is X from Z?
questions.explanation: X is north, Z is east. To get to X from Z, you must move West and North, hence Northwest.

questions.question_text: Four friends P, Q, R, and S are sitting in a circle. P is opposite Q. R is to the immediate right of P. Where is S?
questions.explanation: If P is at 12 o'clock, Q is at 6. R is at 3 o'clock (right of P). Therefore, S must be at 9 o'clock, which is opposite R.

questions.question_text: Statement: Smoking is injurious to health. Conclusion 1: Non-smokers live longer. Conclusion 2: All diseases are caused by smoking.
questions.explanation: Conclusion 1 is an assumption, not stated. Conclusion 2 is an extreme overgeneralization not supported by the statement.

questions.question_text: If Monday is coded as 1-15-14-4-1-25, how is Tuesday coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is replaced by its position in the alphabet: T(20), U(21), E(5), S(19), D(4), A(1), Y(25).

questions.question_text: In a group of 50 people, 30 like tea, 20 like coffee, and 10 like both. How many like neither?
questions.explanation: Using Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion: |T U C| = |T| + |C| - |T n C| = 30 + 20 - 10 = 40. Neither = 50 - 40 = 10.
